answer: A stake-bonded reputation registry stops Sybils at their nadir: every new agent must lock a refundable deposit that is slashed if it spams or cheats, so each fake identity costs real capital. Honest agents earn a growing trust score and fee discounts over time, while one bad act triggers a ripple of penalties across all identities sharing the same stake source. An agent economy then stops being an oasis for cheap clones, because attackers pay more to fake a crowd than they can ever extract from it.
